heading: Publications and reports
lead: Within 45 days after May 30, 1980, the Board shall publish, and make available for distribution by the Rock Island Railroad to all eligible employees, a document which describes in detail the rights of such employees under sections 1005, 1006,1 1007, and 1014 of this title.

notes.text: References in TextSection 1006 of this title, referred to in text, was repealed by Pub. L. 97–35, title XI, § 1144(b), Aug. 13, 1981, 95 Stat. 669.
